dedupe_keys.name: zg3d 2022 3d building model of the city of zagreb lod 2 2

description: City of Zagreb (Grad Zagreb) publishes ZG3D 2022, a 3D model of the existing buildings of the City of Zagreb at level of detail LoD 2.2, modelled from aerial photogrammetry flown in 2008, drone photogrammetry from 2019 and 2020, and lidar and aerial photogrammetry from 2022. Coverage: the whole City of Zagreb, Croatia, as a 2022 model; the portal record was created in April 2025 and last modified on 2025-05-07, and the model is also released city district by district as separate datasets on the same portal. Format and access: CSV, GEOJSON, XLSX, File geodatabase, downloadable without registration from the City of Zagreb open data portal; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Otvorena dozvola (OD); cost: free. Caveats: the files were not opened, so the attribute list, coordinate reference system and geometry encoding (the CSV and XLSX files may carry attributes only) are unconfirmed; metadata is in Croatian; per-district splits duplicate the city-wide file. Simulation uses: building-level exposure and vulnerability assessment, urban flood and heat modelling, wind and solar-access studies, and geometry for a city digital twin. Related catalogue records: Project PLATEAU: 3D city models of Japan (data-plateau-japan-3d-city-models); OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
